## About
Welcome to German Transmission Company of Phoenix. We're a small, independently owned automotive repair shop that specializes in German automobiles, and we've been proudly serving the valley for a good while now.
Adrian is the owner and head mechanic. His philosophy is simple: service with integrity. He's honest and direct about the work, and our goal is quality service at an unbeatable price.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 23 Google reviews. Thank you for supporting local business.

## Services
- Automatic Transmission Rebuilds: Complete and partial rebuilds for Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Audi and Porsche.
- Transmission Check-ups: Bring it in if something feels off and we'll take a look.
- Transmission tune-ups: Regular attention to keep your transmission running right.
- Transmission Maintenance and Flushes: Routine maintenance and fluid flushes for your automatic transmission.
- Brake Services: Brake work done by the same shop you trust with your transmission.
- Oil and Filter Changes: Everyday upkeep for your German car.
- Check Engine Light Diagnostics: Light on? We'll help figure out why.
- New and used automatic transmission parts for German vehicles: We sell new and used transmission parts. Ask us what we have.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in German automobiles. Our transmission rebuilds cover Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Audi and Porsche.

Q: Can I get an estimate?
A: Yes. Give Adrian a call to get an estimate or to ask about any problem your car is having.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're on the SE corner of N 40th St and E Palm Ln, just north of 40th St and McDowell Rd.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're also open Saturday mornings, so give us a call to confirm Saturday hours.
